#!/bin/bash


# ============================================================
# USER SETTINGS
# ============================================================

WORK_DIR="$(pwd)"

FAMILY_LIST="${WORK_DIR}/family_list.txt"

OUTPUT_DIR="${WORK_DIR}/family_models"

# Exact script generated by prepare_ProteinPrep.sh
JOB_SCRIPT_NAME="run_ProteinPrep.sh"

# Maximum number of active jobs
#
# RUN + PEND are counted to prevent the race condition
# where several PEND jobs become RUN at the same time.
MAX_ACTIVE=2

CHECK_INTERVAL=30

# LSF job-name prefix
LSF_JOB_PREFIX="PPREP_"

CONTAINER="/home/cadmol/cadmoladmin/Schrodinger_Containers/Schrodinger_2025-1.sif"


# ============================================================
# CHECK INPUTS
# ============================================================

if [[ ! -f "$FAMILY_LIST" ]]; then
    echo "ERROR: Family list not found:"
    echo "$FAMILY_LIST"
    exit 1
fi

if [[ ! -d "$OUTPUT_DIR" ]]; then
    echo "ERROR: Protein directory not found:"
    echo "$OUTPUT_DIR"
    exit 1
fi


# ============================================================
# COUNT ACTIVE JOBS
# ============================================================

count_active_jobs() {

    bjobs -noheader -o "stat job_name" 2>/dev/null |
        awk -v prefix="$LSF_JOB_PREFIX" '
            ($1 == "RUN" || $1 == "PEND") &&
            index($2, prefix) == 1 {
                count++
            }
            END {
                print count+0
            }
        '
}


# ============================================================
# SHOW ACTIVE JOBS
# ============================================================

show_active_jobs() {

    echo
    echo "Current ProteinPrep jobs:"
    echo "------------------------------------------------------------"

    bjobs -noheader -o "jobid stat job_name" 2>/dev/null |
        awk -v prefix="$LSF_JOB_PREFIX" '
            ($2 == "RUN" || $2 == "PEND") &&
            index($3, prefix) == 1 {
                print
            }
        '

    echo "------------------------------------------------------------"
}


# ============================================================
# WAIT FOR AVAILABLE SLOT
# ============================================================

wait_for_slot() {

    while true
    do

        active_jobs=$(count_active_jobs)

        echo
        echo "Active ProteinPrep jobs: ${active_jobs}/${MAX_ACTIVE}"

        if (( active_jobs < MAX_ACTIVE )); then

            echo "Submission slot available."

            break

        fi

        show_active_jobs

        echo
        echo "Two ProteinPrep jobs are already active."
        echo "Checking again in ${CHECK_INTERVAL} seconds..."

        sleep "$CHECK_INTERVAL"

    done
}


# ============================================================
# LOOP THROUGH PROTEINS
# ============================================================

while IFS= read -r protein
do

    protein="${protein//$'\r'/}"

    [[ -z "$protein" ]] && continue

    [[ "$protein" == \#* ]] && continue


    echo
    echo "============================================================"
    echo "Protein: $protein"
    echo "============================================================"


    PROTEIN_DIR="${OUTPUT_DIR}/${protein}"

    JOB_SCRIPT="${PROTEIN_DIR}/${JOB_SCRIPT_NAME}"


    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # Check folder
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    if [[ ! -d "$PROTEIN_DIR" ]]; then

        echo "WARNING: Missing protein folder:"
        echo "$PROTEIN_DIR"

        continue

    fi


    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # Check ProteinPrep script
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    if [[ ! -f "$JOB_SCRIPT" ]]; then

        echo "WARNING: ProteinPrep script not found:"
        echo "$JOB_SCRIPT"

        echo "Skipping $protein."

        continue

    fi


    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # Wait for available slot
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    wait_for_slot


    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # Enter protein folder
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    cd "$PROTEIN_DIR" || exit 1


    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # LSF job name
    #
    # Example:
    # PPREP_OR51A4
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    LSF_JOBNAME="${LSF_JOB_PREFIX}${protein}"


    echo
    echo "Submitting:"
    echo "  Protein          : $protein"
    echo "  LSF job name     : $LSF_JOBNAME"
    echo "  ProteinPrep file : $JOB_SCRIPT_NAME"


    # ========================================================
    # SUBMIT
    # ========================================================

    lsfcontainer \
        -W 01:00 \
        -J "$LSF_JOBNAME" \
        -n 1 \
        -q standard \
        -gpu 1 \
        -G corp \
        -i "$CONTAINER" \
        "$PWD/$JOB_SCRIPT_NAME"


    submit_status=$?


    if (( submit_status != 0 )); then

        echo
        echo "ERROR: Submission failed for $protein"

        cd "$WORK_DIR" || exit 1

        exit 1

    fi


    echo
    echo "Successfully submitted: $protein"


    cd "$WORK_DIR" || exit 1


    # Allow LSF to register the new job
    sleep 10


    active_jobs=$(count_active_jobs)

    echo "Active jobs after submission: ${active_jobs}/${MAX_ACTIVE}"


done < "$FAMILY_LIST"


echo
echo "============================================================"
echo "ALL PROTEINPREP JOBS SUBMITTED"
echo "============================================================"
